units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|Compared to most of the spaceports you have been to in Successor space, this one is dingy, crowded, and uncomfortable. Most of the Successors you see look equally dirty and unhappy, and the majority of the few ships you've noticed landing are painted in a different, darker shade of red.|336|0
units.english: Compared to most of the spaceports you have been to in Successor space, this one is dingy, crowded, and uncomfortable. Most of the Successors you see look equally dirty and unhappy, and the majority of the few ships you've noticed landing are painted in a different, darker shade of red.
units.raw: `Compared to most of the spaceports you have been to in Successor space, this one is dingy, crowded, and uncomfortable. Most of the Successors you see look equally dirty and unhappy, and the majority of the few ships you've noticed landing are painted in a different, darker shade of red.`

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	You approach one of the crew members disembarking from one of the red-painted ships, which, as you draw closer, you see bears several large burns and scars.|344|0

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"Excuse me, I was wondering if you could tell me about this place. It seems different to the rest of Successor space I've been through."|345|0

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	The Successor looks over at the spaceport for a moment before grunting quietly and deciding to reply. Their voice is lower and darker than that of most Successors you have heard, and their skin changes color and texture rapidly, almost with every word.|346|0
units.english: The Successor looks over at the spaceport for a moment before grunting quietly and deciding to reply. Their voice is lower and darker than that of most Successors you have heard, and their skin changes color and texture rapidly, almost with every word.
units.raw: `	The Successor looks over at the spaceport for a moment before grunting quietly and deciding to reply. Their voice is lower and darker than that of most Successors you have heard, and their skin changes color and texture rapidly, almost with every word.`

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"Thou art the alien vis'tor brought by the Old Houses, art thou not? Their 'noble guest' whom they parade around with such delight?"|349|0
units.english: "Thou art the alien vis'tor brought by the Old Houses, art thou not? Their 'noble guest' whom they parade around with such delight?"
units.raw: `	"Thou art the alien vis'tor brought by the Old Houses, art thou not? Their 'noble guest' whom they parade around with such delight?"`

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"Thou art the alien vis'tor paraded 'round between the Houses, art thou not? Their 'noble guest' or 'flighty knave' that depends on t'which thee speaks?|352|0
units.english: "Thou art the alien vis'tor paraded 'round between the Houses, art thou not? Their 'noble guest' or 'flighty knave' that depends on t'which thee speaks?

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"Yes."|355|0
units.english: "Yes."

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"You could say so."|356|0
units.english: "You could say so."
units.raw: `	"You could say so."`

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	Despite the accusation of being "paraded around," the Successor grunts again at your response; with approval or disgust you cannot tell. They lean against one of the cargo containers on the spaceport floor and continue.|357|0

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"So then thou art another indolent fool, no doubt deceived by their fine promises, of wealth and power so long as you toe the line? Well, look around and see the value of their noble word! The Houses care but naught for you or I or any of them." The Successor gestures to the crowd in a broad sweeping motion.|358|0
units.english: "So then thou art another indolent fool, no doubt deceived by their fine promises, of wealth and power so long as you toe the line? units.raw: `	"So then thou art another indolent fool, no doubt deceived by their fine promises, of wealth and power so long as you toe the line? Well, look around and see the value of their noble word! The Houses care but naught for you or I or any of them." The Successor gestures to the crowd in a broad sweeping motion.`

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"Who are they?"|360|0
units.english: "Who are they?"
units.raw: `	"Who are they?"`

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"I don't think of myself as a fool."|362|0
units.english: "I don't think of myself as a fool."
units.raw: `	"I don't think of myself as a fool."`

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"Then thou art doubly so, because thy time within this space is new and short and so the thoughts contained within thy brain are like those of a child, still blind to the world. But keep thy friends if they appear so kind; and take the time to recollect what I have said when in thy back their dagger nests."|363|0

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	With that, the Successor leaves, rising from the cargo containers and heading silently towards the spaceport.|364|0
units.english: With that, the Successor leaves, rising from the cargo containers and heading silently towards the spaceport.
units.raw: `	With that, the Successor leaves, rising from the cargo containers and heading silently towards the spaceport.`

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"They are the outcasts of the Houses New, who, like the rest, were forced here when the old empire crumbled into ash. But while the rest of the New Houses had ample wealth to move and grow into their new domains, not all of us were able to escape this intermediary place they shoved us into while we waited. A thousand years and still they paint us with their scorn and demonize our yearning to be free."|367|0

units.id: mission:Successors: People's Houses: First Contact|	"Thank you. I have no more questions."|371|0

units.raw: `	"Thank you. I have no more questions."`
